djibouti.title: Flag of the Republic of Djibouti

colors.note: Upper half; represents the Issa Somali people and the sky.
Lower half; represents the Afar people and the earth.
Five-pointed star inside the white triangle; represents unity and the blood of independence martyrs.

desc:
- Two equal horizontal bands of light blue (top) and green (bottom) with a white isosceles triangle at the hoist bearing a red five-pointed star
- The design reflects the nation's two main ethnic groups — the Issa (blue) and Afar (green) — while the white triangle and red star represent peace and unity
- Adopted on 27 June 1977 upon independence from France; the flag was originally the banner of the Ligue Populaire Africaine pour l'Indépendance
- **Construction:** two equal horizontal stripes with a white equilateral triangle extending from the hoist
- The red star is centred within the triangle
- Ratio 2:3
trivia:
- The light blue represents the Issa people; the green represents the Afar people of Djibouti
- The white triangle represents peace; the red star represents unity
- Djibouti's flag emphasizes the balance between its two major ethnic groups
